Kaarigar Clinic Empowers artisans and promotes entrepreneurship by providing business training, digital upskilling, marketing assistance, and collaborations to help artisans establish and grow their businesses while advocating for sustainable, local, and handmade products Silver Certified 2023 80G 12A CSR-1 Transparency Rating: Transparency Rating The transparency rating is calculated based on the amount of information available for the organisation. Is this your profile? Edit now . Send Message Overview PROGRAMS People ABOUT US Social --> Cause Area Primary Sectors Livelihoods Employment Art & Culture Gender Eco-system enabler Skill Development Secondary Sectors Poverty Vocational Training Youth Geographies Served Programs Business Health Checkups District Ahmedabad State Gujarat District Ahmedabad States Gujarat The Business Health Checkups component of the project aims to support artisan businesses by providing them with business analysis and consultancy services. Artisans have the opportunity to have their practices and strategies evaluated by industry experts, financial analysts, and art entrepreneurs. These evaluations help assess the overall health and progress of their enterprises. The project aims to train four cohorts of 25 artisans each year. Kaarigar Ki Dukaan District Ahmedabad State Gujarat District Ahmedabad States Gujarat Kaarigar Ki Dukaan is an online marketplace that offers a wide range of unique artisanal products created by craftspeople from various regions of the country. The marketplace provides buyers with a transparent and reliable shopping experience, showcasing exclusive handcrafted items. By connecting all stakeholders in today's hyper-global digital world, Kaarigar Ki Dukaan aims to strengthen the voice of craftspeople and promote their traditional skills. The marketplace serves as a platform for artisans to showcase and sell their products to a global audience Business wellness Program State Andhra Pradesh Karnataka Tamil Nadu Gujarat Madhya Pradesh Maharashtra Rajasthan Uttar Pradesh Jammu and Kashmir Odisha Chattisgarh States Andhra Pradesh Karnataka Tamil Nadu Gujarat Madhya Pradesh Maharashtra Rajasthan Uttar Pradesh Jammu and Kashmir Odisha Chattisgarh The Business Wellness Program is a certificate course that offers marketing, design, communication, and business training. A class of 50 artisans from diverse backgrounds are invited to join us on a journey of entrepreneurship after careful selection. The program provides one-on-one mentorship, helping each artisan develop their unique business model. Following the philosophy of learning by doing, the course is based on the practical application of the learning to achieve tangible results at the end of it. The mode of teaching, language, and content are well-designed to cater to the needs of the artisans. Our program is based on the values of collaboration, envisioning, practising, implementing, and improving. Udhyam Yatra District Vadodara Ahmedabad Kutch State Gujarat District Vadodara Ahmedabad Kutch States Gujarat As part of our Business Wellness Program, Kaarigar Clinic has launched Kaarigar Udhyam Yatra, an initiative designed to deeply connect with rural artisan communities, understand their challenges, and develop tailored solutions that drive real impact. Through this yatra, we travel to artisan clusters, engaging directly with craftsmen and women to gain firsthand insights into their struggles, aspirations, and business needs. This initiative serves as a bridge between traditional artisans and modern entrepreneurial opportunities, ensuring that the support we provide is relevant, practical, and transformative. Beyond just identifying challenges, Kaarigar Udyam Yatra helps artisans build confidence, resilience, and business acumen. By addressing their specific needs—whether it be market access, financial literacy, or skill enhancement—we empower them to strengthen their enterprises and sustain their craft in an ever-evolving marketplace. kaarigar Seed Fund State Gujarat States Gujarat The Kaarigar Seed Fund is a dedicated support initiative by Kaarigar Clinic to empower rural artisans to become entrepreneurs by providing crucial seed funding, business mentoring, and a platform for growth. The fund is awarded to selected, talented artisans helping them to launch or expand micro-enterprises rooted in their craft and local traditions. kaarigar tank State Gujarat States Gujarat Kaarigar Tank is an innovative platform launched by Kaarigar Clinic to empower artisan entrepreneurs to dream big and showcase their talent. It is modeled as a “pitch” event, where artisans present their business ideas or enterprise innovations to a prestigious jury, much like the popular Shark Tank format but focused on rural craft-based businesses. Impact Metrics Artisans Impacted Program Name Business wellness program Year-wise Metrics 2023-24 135 2024-25 90 Milestones & Track Record One of Kaarigar Clinic's earliest artisan members, Pabiben Rabari, recently raised Rs 50 lakh on the second season of Shark Tank India. --> --> Leadership Team Noopur Kumari Co - Founder & Creative Director Dr. Nilesh Priyadarshi Founder & Chief Executive Officer Om Dudhiya Kaarigar Doctor Raj Rohan kaarigar Doctor Shashank Shekhar Kaarigar Doctor Hariom Jaiswal kaarigar doctor Mansi kaarigar Doctor Demographics & Structure Organisation Strength None M&E Internal, External Assessors No --> Political & Religious Declarations On Affiliation if any No On Deployment Bias if any No --> Registration Details PAN Card AACTB7748N Registration Number E/2765/Kutch CSR Form 1 CSR00038496 80G AACTB7748NF20216 12A AACTB7748NE20218 FCRA Not Available About Headquarters Ahmedabad, Gujarat Since 2019 Demographies Served Women Men Scheduled Castes Scheduled Tribes Artisans --> Impact 225+ Kaarigar Entrepreneurs Developed and empowered with skills, training, and market access. 60,000+ livelihoods supported through sustainable craft-based enterprises. 5,00,000+ lives impacted by improving incomes, preserving traditional crafts, and building dignity for artisans across India. Kaarigar Clinic proposes to impact 1000 artisans benefitting 1,00,000 lives. Vision and Mission Kaarigar Clinic aims to develop 1000 kaarigar entrepreneurs, thereby impacting the livelihood of 100,000 artisan families, and create a holistic platform called 'Kaarigar Ki Dukan' that will work as a hybrid marketplace for artisans. fields.description: India’s first rural business venture "KAARIGAR CLINIC" is changing the landscape of rural India by empowering artisans to become self-reliant entrepreneurs by giving them identity, value and recognition.
